definition.simple: A special substance that changes color to tell us if something is an acid or a base.
definition.academic: A substance that changes its color in acidic and basic mediums, used to determine whether a given substance is an acid or a base.

common_misconceptions: Indicators react and change the substance itself. (Correction: Indicators only change their own color, they do not permanently alter the substance they are testing.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Relate indicators to a traffic light. Just as traffic lights change color to tell you what to do, indicators change color to tell you what a substance is.
